title: Plugin entry
description: One plugin object under 'plugins' in the 'plugins' state document.

source.description: Source specification for fetching the plugin. Required. May be a relative path string or a structured object.

oneOf.description: Relative path to the plugin source (e.g., './my-plugin').
Structured plugin source (e.g., GitHub or git-subdir).

installed_version.description: Version currently installed by the reconciler.

installed_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the installed plugin files.

available_version.description: Upstream version detected by the periodic update check.

skills.description: Skill names provided by this plugin.

last_checked.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last update check.
